text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: You appear to be in good health, Gentile.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I have heard the rumors. That you 
continue to prove your strength at the 
academy."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
However, I can faintly sense it. A certain 
"slackness" in your mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(True... my weight gain lately has been 
more than anticipated.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(I assumed the weight gain was just from 
building muscle, but I might need to 
reconsider that.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful for your advice, 
Father.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Examine oneself carefully――I shall reform 
my way of being, and present further proof 
of the truly strong."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, a re-focused Gentildonna dieted 
to shed some weight.
